newsitem.title: UK: BA fund names Bankers Trust custodians.
newsitem.headline: BA fund names Bankers Trust custodians.

text.p: Trustees of the 7.4 billion sterling British Airways plc pension fund on Wednesday appointed Bankers Trust Co as global custodians of the fund's worldwide investments, Bankers Trust said.
In a statement, Bankers Trust said it would also provide securities lending and ancillary administrative services to the fund.
The previous global custodian of the fund was Barclays.
Bankers Trust administers $2 trillion in custodial assets for clients worldwide.
Fund secretary Jenny Rosser told Reuters the change followed a regular review of its fund arrangements.
